description:
Discover the 2023 Nissan Pathfinder Platinum, a three-row SUV built for families and adventures alike. This Tan exterior model combines robust capability with refined comfort, backed by a proven 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission and standard 4WD for confident handling in any condition.

- Cross Bars
- Cargo Package with dividers, console net, and cargo protector
- LED Fog Lamps
- Bose Premium Audio System with 13 speakers and SiriusXM
- NissanConnect Navigation & Services
- Power Moonroof
- Heated and cooled front bucket seats
- Heated steering wheel
- Memory seat with power driver and passenger adjustment
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Heads-Up Display
- 20 Machined alloy wheels
- Rear backup camera
- Emergency communication system

Every detail has been thoughtfully designed to enhance your driving experience. Step inside and find a spacious cabin with semi-aniline leather seating surfaces throughout. The front seats offer heating and cooling functions, while heated rear seats ensure comfort for all passengers. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains your preferred temperature, and the rear air conditioning keeps everyone satisfied on longer journeys.

Technology meets practicality in this Pathfinder. The integrated navigation system connects seamlessly with NissanConnect services, keeping you informed and in control. Power windows, remote keyless entry, and a power liftgate make daily convenience effortless. The telescoping leather-wrapped steering wheel adjusts to your preference and includes mounted audio controls and heating for cold mornings.

Safety is paramount with multiple layers of protection. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags surround occupants, while electronic stability control and traction control technologies work continuously. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering provide responsive handling, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS deliver confident stopping power in all conditions.

Practicality extends to cargo management with the comprehensive cargo package including dividers, cargo protector, and cargo net. The split-folding rear seat and reclining third-row bench accommodate passengers or expand your storage options. The 20-mpg city and 25-mpg highway efficiency helps stretch fuel budgets without sacrificing performance or capability.

This Platinum model represents the thoughtful blend of luxury and utility your family deserves. With 24,751 miles and meticulous maintenance, this Pathfinder delivers years of dependable service ahead. Visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence, responsive handling, and premium interior appointments in person.

description:
Meet the 2027 Kia Seltos X-Line S, a compact crossover designed for buyers who value practicality without compromise.

- 2.0L I4 MPI engine with CVT transmission and AWD
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto connectivity
- Heated front bucket seats with 3-step heating
- 18" alloy wheels with gloss black finish
- SynTex artificial leather seat trim
- Rear exterior parking camera
- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off feature
- Front fog lights
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- 6-speaker AM/FM display audio with SiriusXM
- Speed-sensing steering
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags
- 911 Connect emergency communication system
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel

The Seltos X-Line S combines efficient performance with everyday practicality. Its 2.0L four-cylinder engine delivers balanced power while the continuously variable transmission works seamlessly with all-wheel drive to handle varied driving conditions. The EPA estimates 26 miles per gallon in the city and 30 on the highway, providing reasonable efficiency for a vehicle in this category.

Inside, you'll find comfort features designed for daily driving. The heated front seats adjust to your preference with three temperature settings, while the SynTex artificial leather trimming offers durability and easy maintenance. The split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, and the rear seat center armrest adds convenience for passengers. Climate control and power windows keep occupants comfortable regardless of weather.

Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto allow seamless smartphone integration through the AM/FM display audio system, while SiriusXM satellite radio expands your entertainment options. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you adjust settings without taking your hands off the wheel, and the trip computer provides useful driving information.

Safety receives focused attention throughout the design. The vehicle includes dual front and side impact airbags, an overhead airbag, and rear side impact protection. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together to enhance stability, while the rear exterior parking camera assists with backing up. The low tire pressure warning system helps maintain proper inflation, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power. Emergency communication through 911 Connect offers added peace of mind.

The exterior reflects the X-Line S designation with purposeful styling. The 18-inch alloy wheels with gloss black finish complement the body-color bumpers and spoiler. Heated power door mirrors provide defroster capability for winter conditions, and the rear window wiper with variably intermittent operation adapts to weather. Auto high-beam headlights enhance visibility while reducing manual adjustment.

This 2027 Kia Seltos X-Line S arrives with just five miles on the odometer, ready for your ownership. The combination of efficiency, safety, and practical features makes this crossover a solid choice for drivers seeking reliable transportation. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience what this vehicle offers firsthand.

For transparent, convenient shopping we classify each of our pre-owned vehicles into 1 of 4 tiers: Gold Certified, Silver Certified, Bronze Certified, and Backlot Certified. The overall goal of this program is to provide a simple, efficient purchase experience.

To be Gold Certified, a vehicle must exceed PA's minimum safety standards by a significant margin. In addition, it must have matching name-brand tires with at least 50% tread remaining, as well as clean brake rotor surfaces with at least 50% pad life remaining. All systems must pass a full functionality test and no drivability issues may be present. All factory recommended services must be performed by one of our technicians. Further, the Carfax History Report may have no negative comments. And notably, its cosmetic condition must be virtually perfect inside and out. If the vehicle passes all of this criteria, it is ''Gold Certified''.

A Silver Certified vehicle is very similar. However it may have some minor blemishes that can be seen when performing a close-up inspection. In addition, a few minor Carfax issues may be present. Nontheless, one's first impression of these vehicles will be very positive.

A Bronze Certified vehicle will have some cosmetic flaws or damage that are noticeable-even when doing a quick walk-around inspection. However it will have met a mechanical criteria nearly identical to our higher tiers.

And now for ''Backlot''. The overall condition of a Backlot vehicle is the lowest we offer. Tires may be off-brand. Some holes may be noticeable in the carpet or seats. Damaged or repainted exterior panels may be quite noticeable, even from a distance. In spite of these lower standards, we still stand behind the ''Backlot'' tier with a basic version of our warranty. The beauty is in the savings!

Here's a bit of information about our company. We specialize in providing thoroughly inspected, serviced, detailed, pre-owned passenger vans and business vehicles. Our in-house, nation-wide ''Golden Rule Warranty'' backs issues not covered by remaining factory warranty as well as unexpected big dollar repairs on vehicles with expired factory warranty. It's included in all transactions gratis! We also offer nationwide transportation, airport pickup, and competive financing.

Above all, we strive to live out the GOLDEN RULE as taught by Jesus Christ- treating others as we wish to be treated. Delayed disclosure of major fees, hidden charges, poor customer service, polished incompentence, and such like violate His Sacred Rule.

All customers, whether Mr. Nice or Mr. Arm Twister, benefit from our market-based ''no haggle'' pricing model. Transactions that do not include a trade-in receive small discounts. Repeat customers receive a bit more. And a package deal of 2 or more vehicles is handled with similiar rationale. To keep our document fees reasonable, we vary them according to the complexity of the transaction. Upon request, we'll provide an out-the-door proposal within a few minutes.

In summary, we strive to provide a simple, GOLDEN RULE experience for each customer-the Jones Family and the Jones Fleet. Nearby and far. For the first time and the 10th time. - Daryl and Miriam Martin (Owners)

Four-wheel alignment
Virginia state inspection
Full professional detail

Then in February 2026, Steven Toyota performed additional maintenance including a brake-fluid service, rear differential service, cabin air filter replacement and throttle-body service.

Combine that recent maintenance with the fresh service performed during our current reconditioning, and there is a very good story behind this RAV4.

At 58,446 miles, this RAV4 has averaged considerably fewer miles than the industry norm. CARFAX specifically identifies it as a low-mileage vehicle, with its longtime owner averaging only about 9,242 miles annually.

It's also an XSE Hybrid AWD one of the most desirable configurations in the RAV4 lineup finished in Blizzard Pearl and backed by a documented six-year ownership and maintenance history.

This isn't a perfect-history vehicle, and we're not going to advertise it as one. CARFAX reports minor damage from 2023, and our inspection found a couple of cosmetic imperfections that we're telling you about upfront.

What you're also getting is a one-owner Virginia RAV4 Hybrid XSE with only 58,446 miles, extensive service history, recent major maintenance and fresh reconditioning.

We know where it came from. We know how it was maintained. We inspected it again before offering it for sale. And we're showing you the good along with the imperfections. That's Total Transparency.

We have just taken in a 2018 GMC Sierra 1500 SLE Extended Cab Pickup - it is finished in Gray, with a Jet Black cloth interior. For the buyer who wants one truck that can handle weekday jobs, weekend projects, and everyday driving, this SLE hits a practical sweet spot. The 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 delivers 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque, so there is satisfying strength under your right foot when merging, hauling gear, or putting the truck to work.

Tow/haul mode helps the transmission manage demanding loads, while the active 2-speed Autotrac transfer case lets you dial in 4WD capability when weather, loose surfaces, or rough access roads call for extra traction. A heavy-duty locking rear differential, front recovery hooks, and a fully boxed frame add the kind of hardware truck buyers appreciate.

The bed is designed to make real work easier. CornerStep rear bumper steps give you a convenient foothold when reaching into the box, LED cargo-box lighting brightens late-day loading, and the EZ-Lift and Lower tailgate makes opening and closing feel controlled instead of cumbersome. A remote locking tailgate adds everyday convenience and security.

Inside, the SLE feels comfortable and straightforward. The 40/20/40 split front seat with heated bucket seats gives you flexible seating and useful storage, while the rear 60/40 bench folds up when you need extra interior room for tools, groceries, or gear you would rather keep protected. A leather-wrapped steering wheel puts cruise and audio controls within easy reach, and power windows, power locks, keyless entry, air conditioning, and heated power mirrors make daily use easy.

When it is time to back into a tight spot or line up near a trailer, the Rear Vision Camera and rear park assist sensors give you a helpful view behind the truck. StabiliTrak with traction control, trailer sway control, hill start assist, 4-wheel antilock disc brakes, and a tire pressure monitoring system add confidence on changing roads.

If you have been looking for a lower-mileage V8 4WD pickup with useful bed features, comfortable everyday equipment, and proven Sierra capability, this one deserves a closer look. Call, text, email, or start your purchase online today before this Sierra finds its next driveway.

CAPABLE, VERSATILE, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, ADVENTURE-READY EVERY DAY! The 2021 Subaru Crosstrek continues to blur the line between compact SUV and rugged hatchback, and this Premium example backs that versatility with a documented no-accident history. Finished in Ice Silver Metallic, this Crosstrek pairs Subaru's standard all-weather capability with the kind of everyday-friendly size that makes it equally at home on a trailhead or in a parking garage.

Between the contrasting orange-stitched cabin, HomeLink-equipped mirror, and standard EyeSight safety suite, this Crosstrek offers genuine everyday personality on top of the capability Subaru is known for. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The Crosstrek has built a loyal following by offering genuine all-weather capability in a size that's easy to live with every day. Standard Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive and 8.7 inches of ground clearance give it real confidence beyond the pavement, a genuine advantage over rivals that only offer all-wheel drive as a costly add-on.

Buyers are also drawn to the Crosstrek for its strong resale value and comprehensive standard safety technology, a combination that's helped it earn a loyal following among buyers who want genuine capability without stepping up to a larger, thirstier SUV. For shoppers who split their time between the trailhead and the daily commute, the Crosstrek remains a compelling choice. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION The Crosstrek has earned consistent recognition from safety authorities and industry evaluators for its combination of standard capability and comprehensive safety technology.
KBB Best Resale Value Award -- Compact SUV IIHS Top Safety Pick (CVT-equipped models) WARRANTY With about 42,600 miles on the odometer, this Crosstrek has aged past its factory coverage window, including Subaru's Basic, Powertrain, and Rust Perforation warranties.

Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind and help protect your investment moving forward. STANDARD FEATURES This Crosstrek's CVT pairing unlocks Subaru's full EyeSight Driver Assist Technology suite, including advanced adaptive cruise control with lane centering, a genuinely comprehensive safety package not available with the manual transmission. The Premium trim adds a leather-wrapped shift lever and contrasting interior stitching over the base model, while a high-grade combination meter with color LCD display, an illuminated center console storage tray, and Tire Pressure Monitoring with individual wheel display round out a thoughtfully equipped cabin. INSTALLED OPTIONS Standalone Features Auto-Dimming Mirror with Compass and HomeLink Reduces glare from headlights behind you at night while adding built-in garage-door and gate control, eliminating the need for a separate remote. Splash Guards Help protect the lower body panels and paint from road spray, mud, and debris kicked up by the tires. Map and Dome Light LED Upgrade Brightens the cabin with crisper, more efficient interior lighting than the standard bulbs. MECHANICAL FEATURES Power comes from Subaru's 2.0-liter Boxer four-cylinder engine, producing 152 horsepower and 145 lb-ft of torque with the kind of low center-of-gravity balance that's become a Subaru hallmark. The Lineartronic CVT delivers smooth, efficient power delivery, keeping the engine in its comfortable range for everyday commuting.

Subaru's Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive sends power to all four wheels continuously rather than only when slip is detected, giving this Crosstrek genuinely confident traction in rain, snow, or loose surfaces. Standard X-MODE with Hill Descent Control on CVT-equipped models further optimizes throttle response and traction for low-grip conditions, making this Crosstrek a legitimately capable companion well beyond the pavement. EXTERIOR FEATURES Ice Silver Metallic gives this Crosstrek a clean, versatile look that pairs well with its rugged, cladded body >

The Forester Premium delivers excellent fuel efficiency, achieving 26 MPG in the city and 33 MPG on the highway. This means fewer trips to the pump and more time enjoying the road. The 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with the Lineartronic continuously variable transmission provides a smooth, responsive driving experience suitable for both daily commutes and longer journeys.

Standard AWD ensures confident handling across various road conditions, from wet surfaces to light snow. The four-wheel independent suspension absorbs bumps effectively while maintaining composed body control. Traction control and electronic stability control work together to enhance grip and prevent skidding when conditions demand it.

The panoramic moonroof creates an open, airy cabin atmosphere. Climate control adjusts automatically to maintain your preferred temperature, while the telescoping steering wheel and tilt adjustments let you find your ideal driving position.

Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. The Subaru Starlink multimedia system works seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, giving you access to navigation, music, and communication apps through the 6.5-inch display. SiriusXM satellite radio provides entertainment options across a wide range of channels. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road.

Safety features include dual front airbags, front and rear side airbags, knee airbags, and an overhead airbag system. An occupant sensing airbag provides intelligent protection, while brake assist supports your stopping power. The emergency communication system through STARLINK offers added peace of mind on every drive.

This Forester Premium is ready to serve as your dependable companion through the seasons. Visit us today to take the wheel and confirm that this vehicle meets your needs and fits your lifestyle.

This 2020 Land Rover Range Rover Evoque S delivers refined capability with practical everyday versatility in a compact luxury package.

- 180 Watt Range Rover Sound System with 6 speakers
- Touch Pro Infotainment system with 10 touchscreen
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- InControl Navigation Pro with rear parking camera
- Leather-trimmed front bucket seats with power adjustment
- Heated power door mirrors with auto-dimming capability
- All-wheel drive with four-wheel independent suspension
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Rain-sensing wipers with rear window wiper
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control
- Remote keyless entry with security system
- 18 alloy wheels with all-season capability
- InControl Protect emergency communication system
- Speed-sensing power steering
- Steering wheel mounted audio controls

The cabin presents quality craftsmanship with grained leather seating, a leather shift knob, and a telescoping tilt steering wheel that adjusts to your preferred driving position. The 10-way power adjustable front seats with split folding rear capability accommodate both comfort and flexibility for cargo management. Dual-zone climate control keeps passengers comfortable regardless of season, while overhead and front reading lights provide ambient convenience throughout the interior.

Technology integration extends across multiple systems designed for modern driving. The Touch Pro infotainment interface with a 10-inch touchscreen coordinates with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto for smartphone integration. The InControl Navigation Pro system pairs with the rear parking camera to assist with maneuvering and route planning. An InControl Protect emergency communication system provides connected vehicle support when needed.

The all-wheel drive system works with four-wheel independent suspension to handle varied road conditions with composure. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and a anti-roll bar configuration at both front and rear contribute to controlled handling. Speed-sensing power steering adjusts responsiveness based on driving speed, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide stopping confidence. The I4 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission delivers 20 city miles per gallon and 27 highway miles per gallon for reasonable fuel economy in its class.

Safety systems include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Low tire pressure warning keeps you informed of tire condition, while occupant sensing technology adapts airbag deployment. A panic alarm and security system provide additional protection when the vehicle is parked or unattended.

With 44,902 miles on the odometer, this Range Rover Evoque S remains well-maintained and ready to serve your needs for years to come. The combination of luxury appointments, capability features, and connected technology makes this an attractive option for drivers seeking a refined compact utility vehicle.

Discover the versatility and dependability of this 2020 Honda Pilot EX-L, a three-row family SUV designed to handle whatever your lifestyle demands.

- 3.5L V6 engine with 6-speed automatic transmission and AWD
- Leather seat trim with heated front bucket seats and power driver/passenger seating
- Power moonroof with automatic operation
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Collision Mitigation Braking System (CMBS) with forward collision warning
- Lane Keeping Assist System (LKAS) active safety technology
- Blind Spot Information (BSI) System warning
- Automatic high-beam headlights with front fog lights
- Dual zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- 215-watt audio system with SiriusXM satellite radio and steering wheel controls
- 8-passenger seating with 3rd row split-bench and reclining capability
- Power liftgate with rear window wiper
- Remote keyless entry with HomeLink garage door transmitter
- 18-inch machine-finished alloy wheels
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display

The EX-L trim elevates the Pilot experience with genuine leather seating throughout, heated front seats for comfort during colder months, and a power moonroof that brings natural light into the cabin. The memory driver seat ensures your preferred position is always just one button away, while the power passenger seat accommodates various needs with ease.

Safety technology is paramount in this Pilot. The forward collision warning system provides early detection of potential hazards, while the lane keeping assist helps you maintain your lane during highway driving. The blind spot information system alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, and electronic stability control works continuously to enhance traction and control.

Daily convenience features abound in this model. Automatic temperature control maintains your preferred climate with dual front zones and dedicated rear air conditioning for passenger comfort. The SiriusXM satellite radio keeps your entertainment options limitless, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity allows seamless smartphone integration through the audio system's controls.

With three rows of seating, this Pilot accommodates up to eight passengers, making it ideal for families or group travel. The front bucket seats offer comfort for long drives, the second row provides ample space, and the third row folds to create expansive cargo room when needed. Split-folding capabilities give you flexibility to configure the interior for either passengers or cargo as situations change.

This white 2020 Pilot EX-L combines practical SUV capability with refined features designed for modern family life. Whether you're commuting through the city or taking a road trip, this vehicle delivers the space, safety, and comfort you're looking for. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this Pilot firsthand.

We invite you to schedule a time to examine this capable crossover in person and discuss how it can meet your transportation requirements.
